cells.normalized_text: Weakened Enemies receive 15% [7.5%] increased damage and 20% Decreased Movement Speed for 6 [2.5] seconds. Weakened Combatants become less accurate and slower. Unique Weaken Effects: Certain sources of Weaken inflict a dramatically stronger weaken that grants 30% [generally 50%] increased damage. Shadowshot: Moebius grants 30% [50%] increased damage against tethered enemies. Felwinter's Helm's Warlord's End grants 30% [30%] increased damage against enemies affected by its weakening burst. Tractor Cannon's Repulsor Force and Fafnir (Quantum Nova Active) grants 30% [50%] increased damage against enemies it damages. Fafnir's, Felwinter's, Tractor's weaken duration can be extended by any other Weaken effect. Shadowshot: Deadfall uniquely grants 35% [50%?] increased damage against tethered enemies.

implementation.classification: Observe live recipient before status authorization; native player selects Guardian parameters, independently of global world mode. Normal callers use6/2.5 seconds and.15/.075 delta.
implementation.sharing: One target instance; MAX_REMAINING deadline and max(old,new) strength; first origin/generation retained. Supports refreshable strong Weaken content; does not implement tether lifecycle.
implementation.damage: Live target defense global_debuff MAX before independent resistance. Existing empty profiles remain neutral.
implementation.movement: -0.2 delta in shared multiplicative status stage of movement speed; actual native attribute projection only.
implementation.lifecycle: Explicit cleanse, expiry and confirmed death clean target state; source detach retains already applied status. Kill facts retain pre-death Buff observation.
implementation.errors: Nonpositive inputs, unavailable/dead recipient or rejected status never write a new strength; unknown authorization stops without invented status or replay.
